study type: retrospective, observational, before-after quality improvement study
exposure: bundled interventions to maintain the warm chain
outcome: temperature checks per day during hospitalization
cohort: The study included neonates admitted to a Sub-Saharan referral hospital in Ethiopia during two periods: pre-intervention (December 2023-February 2024) and post-intervention (April-June 2024).
finding: The implementation of bundled interventions improved neonatal temperature at admission and during hospitalization, and reduced hypothermia episodes during hospitalization.
